'''May 2000 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Cloud, MN on 20 May 2000. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d768">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-st-cloud-minnesota-5-20-00d768/ st-cloud-minnesota-5-20-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-st-cloud-minnesota-5-20-00d768/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
